comparison.objective: Measure an aluminium pin diameter with a digital caliper while supporting the pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workpiece support, jaw alignment, and low-force caliper closure.
comparison.success_condition: Pin is square between contacting jaws, supported and still, with an accurate reading and no excessive squeeze or drop.
comparison.reason: Metrology with controlled jaw contact is a different ability from manipulating a screen to separate mixed rigid bodies. The many spec revisions provide the material outcome details.
